rule_0.statement: THE L7 THEORY: a cached verification result (e.g. 'record set S on baseline B reproduces trace T bit-exact') is reusable EXACTLY while its SEMANTIC dependency closure is unchanged, and that closure is COMPUTABLE from record content and the declared boundary (typed reads/writes, record-input producer edges, reset semantics, numeric policy, domain, horizon) -- never from names, text, or full-content digests alone (metadata is not semantics: a citation cannot change a bit). Further: complete lossless replay match (every boundary output AND state transition, floats by uint64 bits, never decimals) + physics-unchanged + measured determinism ENTITLE the same-trajectory-by-induction certificate, the narrow rerun-skip result for law-swaps that provably preserve outputs in-domain. A description survives any result; a theory can lose.
rule_0.prediction: P-CLOSURE: the producer closure of the real pilot two-law set is EXACTLY {touch_band, stand_first_hold} with the single edge stand_first_hold -> touch_band via the record-input quantities gait.touch.{leg}. P-FOUR-FIXTURES: (a) producer constant/expr change, (b) reset-rule change (event or initial), (c) numeric-policy change EACH invalidate; (d) metadata-label change does NOT (drift recorded, never silent). P-CERTIFICATE: a certificate issues over the registered substrate with mismatches==[] and the reuse decision costs orders of magnitude less than a re-run.
rule_0.falsifier: F-STALE-CERTIFICATE: any result reported REUSABLE after a semantic dependency changed (probes: fixtures a/b/c and the waiver-on-drift probe). F-UNJUSTIFIED-RERUN-SKIP: a rerun waiver granted without every certificate assumption holding (incomplete/lossy match, physics drift, determinism unproven, horizon uncovered). F-OVER-INVALIDATE (the (d) guard): a metadata-only change declared INVALIDATED.
